_comment: Client-facing copy. Edit freely - the bot re-reads this file on every draft.
This message RE-CONFIRMS a date the client already agreed with their CSR.
It is not asking them to pick or approve a date - keep it that way.
{placeholder} is filled from the Trello card. [[ ... ]] wraps an optional
chunk that disappears when a placeholder inside it is empty, so a card
without a launch time or hub link still reads naturally.
Available: agentMention, agentName, clientName, campaignLabel, teamName,
sms: Hi[[ {agentName}]], this is {teamName}. Your {campaignLabel} is complete and everything is ready for your launch on {goLiveShort}[[ ({goLiveRelative})]][[ at {goLiveTime}]][[ {timezoneLabel}]]. Your sheet: {sheetUrl} Nothing needed from you - just re-confirming your live date. If anything has changed, let us know.
smsNudge: Hi[[ {agentName}]], {teamName} here. We posted this in your Discord channel too: your {campaignLabel} is complete and everything is ready for your launch on {goLiveShort}[[ ({goLiveRelative})]]. Your sheet: {sheetUrl} Nothing needed from you - just re-confirming your live date.
